messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — we need a compact migration guide + deprecation banner for the v1 -> v2 SDK switch (client.submit -> client.invoke). Target soft-announcement next Tue.
omar: Got it. Can you paste a minimal PR body and example snippets here so I can fork and start the draft?
liam: Ill take the guide page. Keep it short: minimal example, bullet list of breaking changes, and a short testing checklist.
sophie: Ill open the banner + redirect PR. We should redirect old /docs/v1-invoke to /docs/v2-invoke and show a prominent banner for 30 days.
elaine: Timeline proposal: soft-announcement (email + banner) on Tue, 30-day deprecation banner, hard sunset in 90 days. Also include a 14-day automatic alias routing grace period.
omar: Snippet idea: show direct side-by-side old vs new in both JS and Python. Also call out param rename and embed dimension change.
liam: Example JS snippet for the guide: ```js
// old
const res = await client.submit({ model: 'text-1', input: 'hello' })
// new
const res = await client.invoke({ model: 'text-2', input: 'hello' })
```
sophie: Add a small compatibility note on redirects: keep old links working but surface the banner and link to the migration guide.
kevin: Will SRE/support need a heads-up? Ill schedule a 15-min sync to set up monitoring for fallback routing and error spikes.
doc-bot: NOTE: automatic alias routing is enabled for 14 days after the soft-announcement. After that, explicit model mappings are required.
elaine: Good. Also include a short table in the guide of key renames and recommended fallbacks: - num_tokens -> max_tokens; - embed.dim: 1024 -> 1536 for embed-v2; - model id renames (text-1 -> text-2).
omar: Draft PR body (WIP): one-paragraph summary, timeline, migration snippets, checklist: update SDK calls, run smoke tests, verify embedding dims, run token-count diff. Ill paste the draft PR link here when its ready.
liam: Tests to add: smoke test ensuring token accounting unchanged, and embedding dimension assertion. Python test snippet: ```py
# old
resp = client.submit(model='embed-1', input='x')
# new
resp = client.invoke(model='embed-2', input='x')
assert len(resp.embedding) == 1536  # expected new dim
```
sophie: Redirect PR note: add 301 redirect for /docs/sdk/submit -> /docs/sdk/invoke and banner component with link to migration guide. Include a short UX text: "v1 submit is deprecated — see migration guide".
kevin: Ill prepare dashboards: fallback routing rate, 4xx/5xx error spikes, and alias usage. Will notify support Slack channel.
doc-bot: REMINDER: tag new pages with `migration-snippets` for analytics.
elaine: Action items: Omar — create docs PR draft; Liam — write migration guide + tests; Sophie — banner + redirect PR; Kevin — notify support/SRE & dashboards; Elaine — compose deprecation email copy.
omar: Will post PR draft link here later today.
sophie: Added checklist items to my PR description: samples, expected outputs, and compatibility notes.
liam: For the guides migration checklist, include: 1) Update callsites from submit -> invoke; 2) Rename params (num_tokens->max_tokens); 3) Run embedding dim smoke checks; 4) Verify streaming & callback hooks.
doc-bot: NOTE: schedule auto-alias removal at T+14 days; keep audit logs of alias fallbacks.
kevin: Sync with support Thurs 10am PT. Ill add calendar invite.
elaine: Thanks all  if any blockers, @me. Will draft the email and a short Slack announcement once PRs are merged.
